posts.title: The death you imagine
posts.description: Odds are, you won’t get it. Maybe a small percentage. If you’ve seen the same movies I have, the soon-to-depart are at home in their comfortable, white linen beds, surrounded by family, the light perfect through the window, their face in a beatific glow, a sublime peace for a life well lived, ready for whatever’s next.
